clips.title: The story
paras: At Dreadmist Peak, a filled sampler holds water gathered by Horde druids from the summit pools. The Cenarion Circle studies the sample to learn what is poisoning wildlife in the northern Barrens.

Dreadmist Peak’s high crags hold pools whose mists shape weather and rainfall across the northern Barrens. The Burning Blade, who worship demons, made their coven atop the summit, and the water soon soured. Cenarion druids suspect demonic rites poisoned the vapors that feed the surrounding savanna. They send initiates to collect a sample in a special sampler. The foul liquid confirms their fears: its corruption can sicken the herds below.
